observations: Three-piece industrial equipment set: a blow molding unit, a preform heating unit, and an air compressor.
All units are wrapped in clear protective plastic film.
The blow molding unit (left) features two analog pressure gauges and a digital control interface.
The heating unit (center) has a vertical control panel with multiple digital temperature controllers.
The air compressor (right) is a horizontal tank model with a top-mounted motor and pump.
A watermark 'BESTO EQUIPMENTS' is present on all images.
The text 'SHENG' is partially visible on the compressor tank in photo 2.

identity.kind: semi-automatic PET bottle blowing machine system

claims.evidence: The components shown (blower, heater, and high-pressure compressor) are the standard setup for this machine type.

claims.claim: used to blow different sizes of plastic bottles
claims.evidence: The specific bottle sizes depend on the machine's stroke/clamping capacity and the molds provided, which are not shown.
